module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter DEPTH = 16,
    parameter WIDTH = 8,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        // Define the dual-port RAM instance here
        <instance id="RAM_inst">
            <module_ref id="dual_port_RAM"/>
            <connection id="wclk" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="wclk"/>
            <connection id="rclk" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="rclk"/>
            <connection id="wen" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="wenc"/>
            <connection id="ren" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="renc"/>
            <connection id="wdata" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="wdata"/>
            <connection id="rdata" src_module_id="dual_port_RAM" dest_module_id="asyn_fifo" port_id="rdata"/>
            <connection id="waddr" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="waddr"/>
            <connection id="raddr" src_module_id="asyn_fifo" dest_module_id="dual_port_RAM" port_id="raddr"/>
        </instance>
        
        // Define the write pointer logic here
        <reg id="waddr_bin" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))-1:0]">Binary representation of the write pointer.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            if(~wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 'b0;
            end else if(winc && !wfull) begin
                waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
            end
        </always_comb>
        
        // Define the read pointer logic here
        <reg id="raddr_bin" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))-1:0]">Binary representation of the read pointer.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            if(~rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 'b0;
            end else if(rinc && !rempty) begin
                raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
            end
        </always_comb>
        
        // Define the Gray code conversion logic for write pointer here
        <reg id="wptr" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH)):0]">Gray code representation of the write pointer.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            wptr[0] = waddr_bin[0];
            for(integer i = 1; i < $clog2(DEPTH); i=i+1) begin
                wptr[i] = wptr[i-1] ^ waddr_bin[i];
            end
            wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)] = wptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1] ^ waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)];
        end
        
        // Define the Gray code conversion logic for read pointer here
        <reg id="rptr" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH)):0]">Gray code representation of the read pointer.</reg>
        <always_comb>
            rptr[0] = raddr_bin[0];
            for(integer i = 1; i < $clog2(DEPTH); i=i+1) begin
                rptr[i] = rptr[i-1] ^ raddr_bin[i];
            end
            rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)] = rptr[$clog2(DEPTH)-1] ^ raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)];
        end
        
        // Define the buffer registers for write pointer synchronization here
        <reg id="wptr_buff" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))+1:0]">Buffer register for write pointer synchronization.</reg>
        <always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if(!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Define the buffer registers for read pointer synchronization here
        <reg id="rptr_buff" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH))+1:0]">Buffer register for read pointer synchronization.</reg>
        <always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if(!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 'b0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Define the full and empty signal logic here
        <assign id="wfull" value="(wptr == {~rptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)], rptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]} ? 1 : 0)"/>
        <assign id="rempty" value="(rptr == wptr_buff ? 1 : 0)"/>
        
        // Connect the input and output signals to the dual-port RAM instance here
        <assign id="wen" value="winc & ~wfull"/>
        <assign id="ren" value="rinc & ~rempty"/>
        <assign id="waddr" value="waddr_bin"/>
        <assign id="raddr" value="raddr_bin"/>
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Asynchronous FIFO implementation with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</implementation>
</module>
